profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Pendo.io

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
Currently working on Novus.
Launched Agent Analytics from 0 to closed beta in 5 months
TL on a full stack analytics team in Pendo's main app.
 - Signals, Dashboard Templates, Workflows/Journeys

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
TL for full stack (Go/Vue.js) analytics team in Pendo Adopt.
Helped build Pendo Launcher, a Chrome extension.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Briefly worked on Visual Design Studio, Pendo's WYSIWYG tool to create in-app guides and walkthroughs.
Joined Pendo Adopt, a newly formed division in Pendo that targeted the digital adoption employee facing market.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
JavaScript
Vue / Vuex / Vue Router
RxJS
D3 / Highcharts
Node / Express
React
Java / SpingBoot / Project Reactor

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
An early team member on an initiative to improve how EY project teams work on client engagements; part of an overarching strategy to double EY revenue by 2020.

I created a productivity web app using open source technology that helps EY consultants execute client projects.

positions.title: Business Strategy Consultant in Wealth Management, Financial Services Advisory
positions.description:
Successfully transitioned from previous technical roles to a business oriented client facing role in EY's financial services consulting practice. 

I worked with different client on numerous projects ranging from strategic, process improvement and risk/regulatory initiatives for EY clients in the wealth management industry.

positions.title: Catastrophe Risk Analyst
positions.description: A short stint analyzing catastrophe exposures and quantifying financial risk using catastrophe risk modeling software.

positions.title: ETL Developer, Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing
positions.description:
I continued my technical education after college and became an ETL developer. I experienced the full project lifecycle in large scale and complex information environments. 

I designed, developed and tested Ab Initio ETL applications, shell scripts and SQL queries.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: A summer internship that turned into a part time job during my last year of college. I designed, developed and tested back-end Perl web applications for e-commerce and workflow productivity.

educations.schoolName: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
